items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 76:1
items.html: For the aspect of Ima of the smallness of the Nekudim, called DR of Bina — which includes Hesed as well — was taken by the Nukva of Atik. And nothing remained for Ima of Atzilut except half of Bina, from Gevura downward, lacking Hassadim. Thus, the Nukva of Arich Anpin lacks Hassadim; therefore AVI stand at right and left, which indicates a coupling of imparting Hassadim. (Ibid., Sub Header, “And There Is No”)
